from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InstitutionData(BaseModel):
    """An educational institution's data extracted from a single Common Data Set document."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university or college")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The academic reporting period (e.g. 'Fall 2021')")
    undergraduate_enrollment: str | None = Field(description="Total undergraduate enrollment count")
    graduate_enrollment: str | None = Field(description="Total graduate enrollment count")
    student_to_faculty_ratio: str | None = Field(description="The student-to-faculty ratio as reported in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    institutions: list[InstitutionData]
